title: DevFlow Workspace
tagline: Real-time collaborative developer workspace with live syntax highlighting and team boards.
description: A full-stack collaborative platform enabling engineering teams to organize architectural roadmaps, share code snippets with live syntax highlighting, and communicate seamlessly in real time.
features: Real-time synchronized document and whiteboard state using WebSockets
Robust role-based access control (RBAC) with granular team permissions
Markdown editor with live code preview and multi-language syntax highlighting
Integrated search index across all team boards and shared documentation

title: Pulse Metrics Dashboard
tagline: Interactive telemetry dashboard featuring fluid charts and real-time metric streams.
description: A high-performance analytics dashboard designed for monitoring application performance, API response latencies, and user engagement metrics with smooth customizable chart views.
features: Modular dashboard widgets with drag-and-drop customization
Dynamic filtering by time window, geographical zone, and event category
Accessible dark/light color palette optimized for high-density telemetry displays
Responsive layout optimized for high-refresh desktop displays and mobile monitoring

title: CloudVault API Gateway
tagline: Scalable RESTful microservice gateway with rate limiting and automated caching.
description: A resilient backend service architecture designed to route high-volume traffic with low overhead, featuring distributed rate-limiting, token verification, and automated Redis caching.
features: Token-based stateless authentication with JWT rotation
Distributed token-bucket rate limiter backed by Redis
Structured JSON logging with request tracing and latency reporting

title: TaskCraft Cross-Platform App
tagline: Minimalist offline-first task tracker with fluid gesture navigation.
description: A cross-platform mobile application emphasizing focus and friction-free habit tracking. Features offline synchronization, gestural interactions, and customizable priority matrixes.
features: Offline-first local SQLite storage with background cloud synchronization
Fluid swipe gestures for fast item categorization and archive actions
Customizable notification scheduling for daily routines and deadlines
Accessible typography and haptic feedback on completion states
